article.title: 更進新聞：Amazon Ads將DVA+擴至六個市場，包括新加坡
article.summary: Amazon Ads公布DVA+新增六個市場，區內新增新加坡。廣告主可經平台購買展示、影片及音訊廣告。
highlights: 新增市場另有比利時、波蘭、愛爾蘭、埃及和南非。
Amazon列出統一報表及Amazon Marketing Cloud接入。
article.why: 亞太代理商可在新加坡按同一活動檢查多種廣告版型及報表口徑。
article.next_step: 先核對帳戶和版位資格，再用同一受眾設定比較各版型的可用庫存及報表。
article.detail: Amazon Ads把DVA+擴至六個市場，包括新加坡。平台可程式化購買展示、影片及音訊廣告，涵蓋Amazon自有版位和開放網路。Amazon亦列出統一報表和Amazon Marketing Cloud接入。團隊可先確認帳戶所在地與可購版位，再比較各渠道的量度條件。
article.title_en: Update: Amazon Ads expands DVA+ to six markets including Singapore
article.summary_en: Amazon Ads added six DVA+ markets, including Singapore. Advertisers can buy display, video and audio through the platform.
highlights_en: Other new markets are Belgium, Poland, Ireland, Egypt and South Africa.
Amazon lists unified reporting and access to Amazon Marketing Cloud.
article.why_en: APAC agencies can assess formats and reporting in a single Singapore campaign.
article.next_step_en: Check account and placement eligibility, then compare inventory and reports for the same audience across formats.
article.detail_en: Amazon Ads expanded DVA+ to six markets including Singapore. It supports programmatic buying across display, video and audio on Amazon properties and the open internet. Amazon also lists unified reporting and Amazon Marketing Cloud access. Confirm account markets and available placements before comparing measurement across channels.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
article.followup: 11月6日版報道Attain購物受眾接入，今次新增的是DVA+投放市場。
article.followup_en: The November 6 edition covered Attain purchase audiences. This update covers new DVA+ markets.
